conventions.fridge_days: 0-4 C, from purchase or preparation, unopened; low end of the cited range; null = follow the printed date or not applicable
conventions.freezer_days: -18 C, best quality (safe indefinitely at -18 C per USDA); null = does not freeze well
conventions.counter_days: about 20 C; 0 = max 2 h out of the fridge; null = not applicable
conventions.after_open_days: after opening, kept where the product normally lives once opened (fridge for perishables and sauces, cupboard for dry goods, oils, chips); null = not applicable
conventions.risk: high = pathogen risk if exceeded (Listeria, Salmonella, B. cereus, botulism); medium; low = quality only
conventions.source: FK#id = USDA FoodKeeper product id; ST#id = stilltasty.com/fooditems/index/id; ANSES; FSA; USDA cold storage chart; HOUSE = conservative house rule, no single official figure
